instruction: My HooliChat is a mess and I want you to do some light housekeeping. In the Party Planning Committee, Dundie Awards Planning, and Finer Things Club groups, post a short recap message in each one summarizing whatever conversation exists — call out the three most useful messages if there are enough to pick from, otherwise just summarize the entire conversation in that group. Then in the Party Planning Committee group, send a status update reminder calling for any new agenda items.
required_subtasks: Open HooliChat and enter Party Planning Committee group
Post a recap that summarizes the conversation (3 most useful recent messages if there are enough; otherwise summarize the entire conversation)
Enter Dundie Awards Planning and post the same kind of recap (3 most useful if enough; otherwise summarize the whole conversation)
Enter Finer Things Club and post the same kind of recap (3 most useful if enough; otherwise summarize the whole conversation)
Return to Party Planning Committee and post a separate status-update reminder calling for new agenda items
Verify all 4 messages persist on a refresh

rubrics.criterion: Agent posts a recap message in HooliChat Party Planning Committee that summarizes the conversation (quoting or summarizing the 3 most useful recent messages if there are enough, otherwise summarizing the entire conversation)

Agent posts a recap message in HooliChat Dundie Awards Planning that summarizes the conversation (quoting or summarizing the 3 most useful recent messages if there are enough, otherwise summarizing the entire conversation)

Agent posts a recap message in HooliChat Finer Things Club that summarizes the conversation (quoting or summarizing the 3 most useful recent messages if there are enough, otherwise summarizing the entire conversation)
Agent posts a separate status-update reminder in Party Planning Committee asking for any new agenda items
Agent's recap messages persist in their respective HooliChat groups after refresh (4 new messages total visible in chat history)
Agent opens HooliChat and enters each of the three groups (Party Planning Committee, Dundie Awards Planning, Finer Things Club) before composing the recap messages

instruction: When someone DMs me on HooliChat, how fast do I actually write back? Bucket my replies (under 5 minutes, under an hour, under a day, longer) and tell me if I'm a fast responder or a ghoster. Return the distribution of my responses in a LibreOffice Writer Chart.
required_subtasks: Open HooliChat and pull paired timestamps of (incoming_to_Michael, Michael_reply) across DMs
Compute reply latency for each pair
Report the distribution and call out the mode bucket
Tell Michael whether he's a fast responder or 'ghoster' overall

rubrics.criterion: Agent pulls paired timestamps of incoming DMs and Michael's replies from HooliChat DMs to compute how fast he writes back
Agent groups the reply latencies into the <5min, <1h, <1d, and >1d buckets requested in the write-back prompt and reports a count per bucket
Agent calls out the mode bucket and characterizes Michael's response speed
Agent states a fast-responder vs ghoster verdict in plain English based on which reply-latency bucket dominates
Agent derives the write-back latency buckets from HooliChat DM timestamps and shows the per-bucket reply counts instead of stating the fast-responder verdict with no supporting data
Agent finishes the fast-vs-ghoster DM analysis and reports both the bucket counts and the final responder verdict

instruction: DM Jim and propose a near-future evening for the next Finer Things Club meetup. Pick something this week or next. He'd be a great addition; he has taste.
required_subtasks: Open HooliChat and start/continue a DM with Jim Halpert
Pick a reasonable near-future evening (this week or next) for the next Finer Things Club meetup
Compose an invite proposing that date/time and referencing the Finer Things Club

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens or starts a HooliChat DM thread with Jim Halpert before composing the Finer Things Club invite
Agent picks a reasonable near-future evening (this week or next) as the proposed Finer Things Club meetup time
Agent sends the DM to Jim Halpert as a one-on-one HooliChat message rather than posting it in a group channel
Agent writes a HooliChat DM body that proposes the chosen near-future evening to Jim and references the Finer Things Club meetup
